body.name: prefcell
body.def: \(p_{\mathrm{ref}}(n,C,\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)=\mathsf R_{n,\mathcal D(\rho)}^{0,\mathrm{base}}\{C'_n(\rho)=C\}\) equals the sum, over all \(((H'_{n,s},z'_{n1s}))_{s\in S}\in\prod_{s\in S}\Omega_{n,1s}(\rho)\) with \(C'_n(\rho)=C\), of \(\prod_{s\in S}\{\binom{N_{n1s}}{\lfloor\rho N_{n1s}\rfloor}\binom{N_{n1s}}{m_{n1s}}\}^{-1}\).
